title: Equipment
functions: Tracking and registration of equipment (3D printers, CNC machines, robots)
Online monitoring of equipment condition and utilization
Statistics on operating time, downtime, and errors
Lifecycle management: installation, maintenance, decommissioning
Integration with maintenance and quality modules

title: Integration
functions: Equipment connection: drivers, firmware, interfaces
Integration with CNC machines, 3D printers, controllers, and sensors
Setting up data exchange with external ERP/CRM/MES systems
Firmware updates and remote device diagnostics
Centralized management of peripherals and gateways

title: Logs
functions: Monitoring — analysis of equipment utilization and process efficiency
AI analytics — automatic detection of malfunctions and errors
Search interface — convenient search for failures and reports
Reports — periodic generation of failure reports
Notifications — timely alerts about critical events
Remote access — control from any device from anywhere in the world

title: Planning
functions: Planning of the production process and equipment utilization
Automatic task distribution between machines and lines
Tracking deadlines, priorities, and available resources
Visualization of schedules and bottlenecks in the production chain
Integration with the Equipment and Orders modules
